# ASD-STE100 skill provenance

The [writing standard](../../contracts/writing-standard.md) adapts clarity and meaning-preservation
rules from [danyuchn/asd-ste100-skill](https://github.com/danyuchn/asd-ste100-skill).

- Reviewed version: `0.4.0`.
- Pinned commit: `7d4a135a199a5d7447c4886bcd7ffe742a627bc9`.
- Source: [SKILL.md at the pinned commit](https://github.com/danyuchn/asd-ste100-skill/blob/7d4a135a199a5d7447c4886bcd7ffe742a627bc9/SKILL.md).
- License: [full upstream MIT license](LICENSE).
- Review date: 2026-09-28.

The local adaptation separates chat language from artifact language. It preserves the active
role's task, required evidence, output contract, and permissions. It uses plain technical prose
for explanations and stricter steps for procedures. Meaning takes priority over sentence length.
It omits the upstream rewrite-only response format, mandatory rewrite process, and optional linter.

No official ASD dictionary or certified compliance claim is included. No global skill installation,
new runtime dependency, or automatic upstream update is required. Review a future version before
changing the pinned source and this notice. These provenance files are not routine task context.
